critical.title: ⚡ MACRO REGIME — Fed holds at 3.75–4.00% with two dissents for a hike
critical.text: The FOMC held on 10/28 by 10–2; Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack dissented, both preferring a quarter-point increase. The statement upgraded economic activity to 'strong' and said inflation 'remains elevated'. Chair Kevin Warsh did not commit to a December move, but Reuters (as relayed by CaptainAltcoin) has markets pricing roughly an 80% chance of a December hike (next FOMC December 8–9) — up from ~73% in yesterday's brief. BTC rose above $81,000 on the headline, then fell back under $80,000. Lens impact: Macro/Liquidity stays 🟡 neutral only because ETF inflows and a flat dollar offset the rate path; this is the main downside risk to the composite.
